name: Document scroll
oneLiner: real paper pages of a long document tilt in 3D and get flicked: they fly past in motion blur while a page counter races, settle on a long tail on one page, and a highlighter sweeps the line that matters as the camera pushes in
say: when the speaker says 'buried on page 14 of the terms...', 'I read the whole report' or 'it says right here': the pages fly while they set it up, the highlighter lands on the quoted line
